title: Mark all read clears unread, and is disabled with a tooltip if none
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell icon at the top right (it opens on the Inbox tab).
  3. Have some unread notifications (a second user writes the notes (on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView")): open a work order (top menu Work Orders -> click a work order number (e.g. S2-4219) -> Notes tab) -> New Note, type a message, type @ and pick "Admin ShopView" (or click a tag group pill you belong to under "Tag groups:"), then click Save); then a state with none unread (Mark all read).
custom_steps:
1. With unread notifications present, click Mark all read and re-read the list and the bell badge.
  2. With no unread notifications, look at the Mark all read action and hover it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A Mark all read action marks every unread notification in the inbox as read.
  • When you have no unread notifications, Mark all read is disabled, and hovering it shows the tooltip "No unread notifications".

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10244 (S1, Work the Notifications inbox); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S1; design boards InboxAfter/Main; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R12: “A Mark all read action marks every unread notification as read.”
  • S1-R20: “Mark all read marks every unread notification in the inbox as read.”
  • S1-N2: “When the user has no unread notifications, the Mark all read action is disabled.”
  • S1-N3: “When the user has no unread notifications, hovering the disabled Mark all read action shows the tooltip "No unread notifications".”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
